summary: Iteration 116 — Round 2 Krea testing focused on (A) Krea → Gallery auto-save and (B) imagem_krea as a new improvement type. Full backend validated: 27/27 pytest in test_krea_integration.py pass + 2 new E2E tests created in test_krea_agent_e2e.py. Apply-improvements pipeline accepts type=imagem_krea with kreaModelId + _kreaImage, polls Krea, attaches image to slide, persists via store_asset_async, and returns kreaImagesGenerated=1 in the DONE payload (status=processing@82% → done@100% in ~4s with flux-1-dev). HOWEVER, one CRITICAL bug found: the pipeline's _process_krea_images auto-save to gallery fails silently due to an asyncio event-loop mismatch — same latent bug also affects the Leonardo (line 3145) and Gemini (line 3209) gallery auto-save paths in routes/agent.py. The direct POST /api/krea/jobs/{jobId}/save endpoint (editor 'Usar no Curso' flow) works correctly — gallery has 1 Krea entry with keywords 'krea flux-1-dev: professional leadership workshop...'. Frontend code-level audit confirms typeLabels 'Imagem Krea AI', data-testid krea-model-picker-{i}, Sparkles icon, 3-way picker with rose theming, and category filter chip are all wired in CoursePanels.jsx. Live UI E2E of the 3-way picker not triggered (would require a full LLM analysis cycle + real Krea $0.04 generation beyond the one already run).

critical.issue: Gallery auto-save fails silently in the apply pipeline with "got Future attached to a different loop". Krea image IS generated and attached to slide (kreaImagesGenerated=1) and stored in MongoDB (store_asset_async works), but the image does NOT appear in /api/gallery/images. Root cause: _run_apply_improvements_bg runs the coroutine in a separate event loop (via run_coroutine_threadsafe / new loop in thread), while the Motor db client in routes/gallery.py (imported as module-level `db` from routes.deps) is bound to the main FastAPI loop. Motor futures cannot cross loops. Same bug silently breaks the existing Leonardo (agent.py:3145) and Gemini (agent.py:3209) gallery auto-save side-effects. Evidence from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: 'Failed to auto-save image to gallery (non-fatal): got Future attached to a different loop'. The try/except Exception: pass swallows the error so users never know. Mitigation options: (1) use motor.motor_asyncio.AsyncIOMotorClient created inside the worker loop, (2) use asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe with the main loop, or (3) do a synchronous pymongo insert for the gallery side-effect only.

minor.issue: No minor issues found for the direct Krea save path — it correctly persists to MongoDB and inserts gallery doc with keywords 'krea flux-1-dev: {prompt}' (verified with admin gallery GET returning 1 Krea entry).

Options: (a) instantiate a fresh AsyncIOMotorClient inside the worker for the insert; (b) do a blocking pymongo insert in a thread for the gallery doc; (c) restructure so auto_save_to_gallery is invoked on the main loop via asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe. Remove the bare `except Exception: pass` so failures are observable.

rca of the issue: Root cause: routes/agent.py._process_krea_images (line ~3343) imports routes.gallery.auto_save_to_gallery which uses routes.deps.db (Motor AsyncIOMotorClient). The _run_apply_improvements_bg background worker is scheduled in a thread+new-loop pattern, so the Motor client — which ties its futures to the loop it was created on — raises RuntimeError('got Future attached to a different loop') when awaited. The bare `except Exception: pass` wrapper in agent.py means this is logged only as a WARNING and the apply job reports kreaImagesGenerated=1 (true for MongoDB+slide, false for gallery). Reproduction: submit apply-improvements with a single imagem_krea improvement and poll status; gallery list stays at pre-apply count. Mitigation: inject a loop-correct db or do the gallery insert via pymongo sync client in to_thread.
